title: Sustainable valorization of mandarin peel waste into multifunctional cellulose/pectin/PVA films with superior mechanical and UV-blocking performance
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00465A, Paper

Yongjun Cho, Sunoo Hwang, Pham Thanh Trung Ninh, Youngju Kim, Shinhyeong Choe, Jaewook Myung
We have developed multifunctional, biodegradable plastic films composed of mandarin peel byproducts and poly(vinyl alcohol) through a mild Na2CO3-mediated pretreatment process.
